company: PPIO (派欧云) — operated by 派欧云计算（上海）有限公司 (PPIO Cloud Computing (Shanghai) Co., Ltd.); Hong Kong IPO listing vehicle: PPLabs Technology Limited (派想未来集团)

ownership.quote: 派欧云（PPIO）是国内分布式云计算的先行者，由PPTV创始人姚欣及首席架构师王闻宇于2018年联合创立。

stage.quote: 2026年5月，PPLabs刚刚完成B-2轮优先股融资，规模约为3520万美元。
stage.note: Founded 2018; rounds disclosed in the HK IPO prospectus run Angel (2021-03) → A (2021) → A-1 (2021-11) → A-2 (2022-02) → B (2025-04) → B-2 (first tranche, 2026-05/06). B-2 is an extension/tranche of the Series B, so the last priced round maps to series-b. Company has twice filed a Hong Kong main-board IPO prospectus (lapsed 2025-06, refiled 2026-06) but is not yet listed, so 'public' does not yet apply.

total_funding_usd.basis: 'PPIO已累计完成5亿融资' (cumulative funding of ~RMB 500M) per 智源社区/BAAI hub, converted at ~7.25 CNY/USD. That figure is dated June 2025 (before the 2026 B-2 tranche), so the true cumulative total by the 2026-09-30 check date is higher — at minimum the disclosed B ($21M across two named backers, total round size undisclosed) plus the B-2 tranche ($35.2M) add on top of it.
total_funding_usd.quote: PPIO已累计完成5亿融资，从天使轮起就汇聚了百川智能创始人王小川、前微软Azure中国总裁申元庆，以及迅雷的联创程浩等投资阵容支持。

last_round.quote: 根据招股书，派欧云在2026年6月3日完成了首期B-2轮融资，募集资金总额3520万美元。

revenue.basis: RMB 770M for FY2025 per IPO prospectus as reported by press; converted at ~7.2 CNY/USD
revenue.quote: 财务数据显示，在过去的2023年、2024年、2025年，派欧云的营业收入分别为人民币3.58亿、5.58亿和7.70亿元，相应的净亏损分别为人民币1.89亿、2.94亿和2.23亿元，相应的经调整净亏损分别为人民币0.37亿、0.62亿和1.05亿元。

note: PPIO is the product brand of 派欧云计算（上海）有限公司, founded 2018 by PPTV founder Yao Xin (姚欣) and ex-PPTV chief architect Wang Wenyu (王闻宇, ~10.17% stake). It is a VC-backed, VIE-structured independent company (not a subsidiary of a bigger corporate group); its Hong Kong IPO holding entity is PPLabs Technology Limited (派想未来集团/'派想未来'). It filed for a Hong Kong main-board IPO twice — first in June 2025 (lapsed) and again June 2026 — and is still loss-making (RMB 223M net loss / RMB 105M adjusted net loss in FY2025) though revenue grew from RMB 358M (2023) to RMB 770M (2025), driven by AI cloud/inference revenue (>10x YoY in 2025). Not to be confused with Novita (the card notes 'legal corporate relation to Novita remains unresolved' — no evidence found here that Novita is a corporate parent/subsidiary of PPIO; treat as a separate, unconfirmed question outside this funding research).
